title: Boston Gas Company files a 365 Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Wellesley College.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES Boston Gas Company's proposed Agreement with Wellesley College. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
